notes:
BUILD 99  -  less "generated", more hand-made
- Text: every message, tooltip, item description and job card rewritten short and plain. No more chatty sentences.
- Rust and sheet metal: rust now runs down in streaks and patches instead of an even polka-dot pattern.
- Repeated panels (fences, walls, hulls, painted metal) each get their own patch of texture, so rows of them no longer look copy-pasted.
- Rocks, bushes, ore nodes and loose sticks gather in natural patches instead of an even sprinkle across the map.
- Rocks and loot barrels/crates each have slightly different shades.
- Your footsteps, swings and landings vary in pitch so they never sound like the same clip.
- Landing from a jump or fall dips the camera a little.
